list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) AS __text FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service_name AS __text FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND service_name <> '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: min_severity
list.label: Min severity
list.query: 0 : all,5 : debug,9 : info,13 : warn,17 : error,21 : fatal

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS records FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' AND severity_number >= ${min_severity} AND body LIKE '%${search}%'

SELECT count(*) AS errors FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND severity_number >= 17 AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' AND body LIKE '%${search}%'

SELECT count(DISTINCT service_name) AS services FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$'

panels.title: Unparsed (no severity)
panels.description: Records that no rule parsed successfully: no severity was extracted (either no rule claimed them, or the claiming rule did not match). Events and JSON without a level field count too.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS unparsed FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND severity_number = 0 AND log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] IS NULL AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$'

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(log_attributes['dog.log.rule'] AS VARCHAR), '(none)') AS rule, count(*) AS records FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(timestamp) / 60) * 60) AS time, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'fatal' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'error' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'warn' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'info' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'debug' ELSE 'unset' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' AND severity_number >= ${min_severity} AND body LIKE '%${search}%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT service_name, count(*) AS records FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' AND severity_number >= ${min_severity} AND body LIKE '%${search}%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT timestamp AS time, body AS message, severity_text AS level, service_name AS service, CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) AS namespace, CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS VARCHAR) AS pod, CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.container.name'] AS VARCHAR) AS container, CAST(log_attributes['dog.log.rule'] AS VARCHAR) AS rule FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(resource_attributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS VARCHAR) REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' AND service_name REGEXP '^(${service:regex})$' AND severity_number >= ${min_severity} AND body LIKE '%${search}%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
